items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: You might ask my sister why she doesn't go with me anymore.

ctx.x: When you come back, you visit your family's graves and the shrines and things in our town?

Yes, I do. You see, I have had so many blessings in my life that I made a promise years ago. And this was through my mother and my sister. I don't know what's happened over the last few years. Every time I'd come here, why, she was ready to go with me. Now she doesn't go. But it's one of the promises that I made. I know she'll listen to what I'm saying. That whenever I come here, I would visit the graves of my relatives and pay them the respect that I owe them. Then visit the shrine that my mother introduced me…
You can't reach me through too much. Well, your patron saint is a... St. Jude. Patron saint in lost colleges. Right.
